data.one_liner: Parse, transform and print GraphQL documents in Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides libraries to parse GraphQL strings into an AST, visit and transform the AST, and print it back to a string. Includes experimental schema and operation helpers.
use_when: You need to work with GraphQL query documents at build‑time or runtime without a full client
You want to generate or modify GraphQL queries programmatically
avoid_when: You need a complete GraphQL client with networking and caching
You require code‑generation of Dart models from GraphQL schemas
strengths: Supports parsing, visiting, transforming and printing of GraphQL AST
